title: SMOA: Sparse Mixture of Adapters to Mitigate Multiple Dataset Biases
reasoning: The paper focuses on mitigating various dataset biases in Natural Language Understanding tasks. While it addresses 'biases', these refer to spurious correlations and shallow patterns in datasets (e.g., hypothesis-only bias, inter-sentences bias, lexical feature bias), not biases related to religion, morals, or ethics. There is no component evaluating or benchmarking these specific topics.
